title: Tolkovo realtime: client → server message
description: One JSON text frame from a panel client, at most 1024 bytes. Mutations go over REST (docs/02 §10.2); the socket only resumes the event stream. resume is accepted once per connection, right after hello; anything else closes the connection with 1008.

resume.description: Replay the events of the workspace after last_seq that this connection may see, then resumed (or resync_required).
